applyTo: 'projects/website/**/*.{js,jsx,css,json}'
---

# Developer Website Changes

Read the
[website publishing guide](../../docs/internal/development/website-publishing.md).
Keep canonical public content in `docs/developer`; website source owns only
Docusaurus configuration, assets, navigation, and presentation.

Keep direct dependency versions exact and update `package.json` with
`package-lock.json`. Validate changes with the install, audit, and production
build commands required by the publishing guide.
